company.name: Demostack
company.shortDescription: Demostack provides assistance to software companies in creating, delivering, and analyzing demos.
company.description: Demostack is the world's first demo experience platform. Demostack helps SaaS revenue leaders accelerate growth with custom demos at scale. Demostack allows software companies to create a high fidelity demo of their software product, and tailor it for each conversation in minutes. No code needed. And no more waiting weeks on R&D.

aiResearchSummary.text: Demostack is researching methods for customizing demonstrations of web-based software applications by generating demo recordings with nodes for web pages and resources, as described in 'Customizing demonstrations of web-based software applications.' They are also developing techniques for dynamic and visual recording of web-based application demos, and methods for mobile application cloning to facilitate demo creation. Additionally, they address obfuscation of personally identifiable information in demo environments.
